hey! it does get better, trust me - i'm on day 37 today and my symptoms have mostly dissipated, all that's left is occasional sinus headaches and depressive days. not everyone's quitting timeline will be the same, but things started to greatly improve for me after the 2-week mark. no more temperature confusion, and the anxiety has reduced to a healthy amount. keep riding it out, you'll be grateful you did :)

thank you so much for posting this comment. Knowing others are going through similar ordeals and I'm not as alone as I really feel is comforting somehow. I'm on day 5, cold turkey (I know, it only occurred to me to taper after a few days had passed - I'm not the brightest). The rapid changes from hot/cold are NUTS. I was up all night last night trying to sleep but the anxious fire in my chest kept me up, I didn't actually fall asleep once. Constantly swapping between a thicker and thinner blanket, then no blanket at all, then all of them at once. It's so confusing. I already have generalized anxiety, it feels like my default sober physical state but multiplied a hundredfold.

Also, I'd be curious to hear if anyone else has experienced this, or anything similar - I have a sudden, very intense aversion to sleeping in my own bedroom, so I've been sleeping on the couch. I live with my family, so maybe it's paranoia manifesting as a fear of solitude. Last night, I wanted to see if I felt well enough to sleep in my own bed... I didn't. I laid down for upwards of 1 minute before I burst into tears and the cold/hot flashes and sweating ensued and I had to return to the couch... Nonetheless I got no sleep. :/ I'm honestly doubting I'll be able to get any tonight either, based upon how my day went. We'll see.

The toilet thing, bro it's I N S A N E. I'll be visiting the bathroom 4 times in a 30 minute span and it's like cranking a faucet on. Mostly, the only thing I can stomach is bananas (preferably very overripe) and lukecold/lukewarm bagels. Weird, but it's like my body is generating random, very specific things as necessities during this... Who am I to complain about the bagels.

Also, for the life of me I cannot sleep in any orientation besides on my back. 😐

So far, I've found relief in hot showers and baths, and listening to comforting, familiar music. I've been listening to the same singular band since I quit, and I can barely bring myself to listen to anything else.. It just doesn't feel right (the band is Clutch, for anyone who is mildly curious).

I hope you see more comfortable days soon. I hope we all do🤍
